content: Pole eruyi o mulingu andi o Masedwane na Ngerese
Musighe wunoghabughe, Pole akeghukighe badukitsi nobawarise, mba akebaghanine nowende o Masedwane.
Akesabughe yari yeni, nowarise bakereti bapwele ave amavosilaange nowu. Va djulu vane, akewende o Ngerese
o amatsanine miweli miryeru. Mbé aronde unangeme mu watange nowende o Siri, ave amawululu yi baSwife bamamutungile fundu. Kaboghu, akesitighe muvyoyile adu Masedwane.
Batu abamawendaange nandi: Sopate mwane Pirise mwise Bere, Arisitareke Sekunduse bise Tesalonike, Ghayise mwise Derebe, Timote, Tisike na Torfime bise yari yi Asi.
Bane bakerele notukele o musyengi Torwase.
Yoyine djetu tumanangeme mu watange, mu wende o Filipe, yike mumengu wu bapembi abaghane dufunusu wisuki. Bilumbu biranu va djulu, tumabadale o Torwase o tumavyosile tsone mosi.
Mulingu musitu wu Pole o Torwase
Mu yilumbu yiteghe yi tsone, tumabe tughukeme mudji va mosi. Pole amalonze dibundu, amavose pwele tena ghari wisi, mumba mbé owende va kedi.
Balambi bapwele bamabe o kilingu ndaghu adjitumabe.
Mwa munzambu wumanengulungu Yitikise amatsane va nele ndaghu. Akewende yilu yineni ave Pole amavosila. Yilu yimavyoghulile, tena ave amabonduyile kilingu adji muryeru teno tsi. Akefu.
Pole akevindeme, akemunaghule novose yi: «Dundanu wunyonge, adji monyu.»
Mba akemate, akeghabe pembi nodji. Yike emani akemwévose tinde yitsingu tena kedi, mba akewende.
Bakeghabuse munzambu monyu na dyoni dikebe tinde duwarusu ombu botsu.
Pole eruyi o Torwase tena o Mile
Tumarele uwende mu watange adjimatubeghe o musyengi Asose, o mbé tubongile Pole. Anane amakinzile, mumba amabe na nzale uwendile mu mumbambe.
Anoturasene o Asose, tukemunangighe mu wende o musyengi Mitilene.
Vane, tukewende mu watange. Yilumbu ayimaduke tukebambene na ningi Kyo. Yilumbu yi djulu, tuketole o ningi Samose, mba ayinzime tukedale musyengi Mile.
Pole, asamaronde usikeme o musyengi Yifese, mumba diweru dikévyoghe o yari yi Asi. Amavungilaange utole o Serusaleme, pa mbé dyurungule ube yilumbu yi Patekote.
Pole evosi na bivunde bi Yifese
O musyengi Mile, Pole aketinde yilumbi o dibundu di Yifese mu yélande bivunde byowu.
Banotole va mughule andi, akebatsingule yi: «Dwidjabi nane nyimatsanine nenu, ubongile va yilumbu yiteghe ayi nyimaruyile o yari yi Asi.
Nyimasalile Fumu na divole-mbombu, na matsange na maghughe amenyimalabe dibandu bikumbu bi baSwife.
Dwidjabi yi nyisamasweghe ne dimosi mu motsu amawelimine. Nyimadulonze notsingule motsu, na va ghari batu na mu mandaghu menu.
Nyimanengile baSwife na baNgereke mukalughe dyele na Nzambi, novayile Fumu etu Djesu yitu.
Mba vave, yike o Serusaleme nyiwendi, nane Yinyuni Yisyeme yinzindiyili. Tumbe, ngedjabi adyutuyile ghune.
Nyidjabi yi mu kale musyengi, Yinyuni Yisyeme yindubusi yiri, tsughu na maghughe bikeli.
Tumbe, monyu ami wughane tsongu va wusu ami. Adimbuli murime, uwende teno disukusulu mu manisile yisalu ayi Fumu Djesu amapeghe. Diwendili rye: wulonze Musamu Wuboti wu yese yi Nzambi.»
«Nyimavyose temu nolonzange Bukaghe bu Nzambi, tumbe nyimadjabe yi vagha ne wumosi va ghari enu omwéndabe.
Ladibandu, nyidubongili na muni nane bambedji: yike wumosi va ghari enu etsyemuyi, nga mune dighénzuni.
Mumba nyimadulonze motsu ame Nzambi amasitighe, ne dimosi nyisamasweghe.
Dukebene djenubeni, na kelisanu mughambe, awu Yinyuni Yisyeme amaduveghe. Bandekenanu dibundu di Nzambi adi amadile mu malungu ma mwane andi.
Nyidjabi yi ave nyuwendile, batu bavu nane baminzi ba bukani bokote va ghari enu mba mughambe wughovengusu.
Mba ne va ghari enu, batu bofuraange mu dute badukitsi.
Moghanu kaboghu! Rangeminanu yi, mu bilime biryeru, na nyangu na mukolu, nyisamadunde ulile mu ulubuse kale mutu.
Vave, nyiduwakise ombu Nzambi na musamu wu yese yandi. Ane musughe uduwarise mu yitu, noduveghe disyale adi asweyile bandi.
Nyisamavonde badoli na lore, vo bikutu bi wotsu ke mutu.
Dwidjabi yi nyimasale na makake mami, mu dile abimabe biwelimine na abamandukaange.
Nyimadulase mu motsu yusale abwedji mu wamuse abadede. Mbé turangiminanu ame djabeni Fumu Djesu amavose: “Uveghe atsivyo uveghu nzangu.”»
Yike emani uvose, Pole akekuteme nowu nosambile.
Botsu bamalile pwele na matsange mu misu, bakevyunge Pole mu kingu nomughumbesene.
Bamaningaange mumba Pole amavose yi aghoghabughe. Bakeyemuvetsighe tena o watange.
